prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while changing lanes in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were and what you were doing right before the impact?

A: I was driving on the main road heading toward the shopping center. I was in the left lane and wanted to move over to the right lane because I needed to make a turn coming up. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I thought the lane was clear.

Q: What happened when you started to move over?

A: The other car was in my blind spot, I guess. It was a sideswipe. I felt a bump on the passenger side of my car, and then both cars kind of drifted. I pulled over onto the shoulder once I got control of the steering.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the contact?

A: No, not really. I didn't see it until it was right next to me.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the side window, I think. I've had a headache ever since, and I felt dizzy and foggy for a while afterward. My doctor said it looks like a concussion.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?

A: Some of them. Light bothers my eyes, and I get tired faster than usual. I'm trying to take it easy and I've been told to avoid screens for long stretches.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. I've been seeing my primary care doctor since then for follow-up.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to say I didn't mean for this to happen. I was trying to be careful, but I clearly missed that car.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
